name: 无尽之塔
description: Roguelike dungeon runs (Endless Tower). Migrated out of api/modules/dungeon in P4.3b, following the economy template. Adopts the pre-existing `dungeon_runs` table: its column names are the JSON contract the frontend reads, and the row is returned straight through `SELECT *`.

data._adopted_note: Keeps its legacy name because `SELECT *` rows are returned straight through to the frontend (current_floor, max_floor, active_buffs, current_hp, max_hp, status are read by name), and because api/modules/admin deletes rows from it through Prisma during a user cascade. Renaming is a coordinated change, tracked as namespace debt by guardrail G10.
